shopSub: I check your shop every 5 minutes and warn you before a problem grows.
serverSub: The health of the Pilotix server: machine, database, automatic tasks, code errors and shops.
demoNote: Preview: there is no server here, these numbers are an example. On your server, the Doctor shows the real ones.
allGoodSub: Nothing to fix right now. I keep watching.

stockOut.title_one: {{count}} product is missing for orders already confirmed
stockOut.title_other: {{count}} products are missing for orders already confirmed
stockOut.title: {{count}} products are missing for orders already confirmed
stockOut.why: {{orders}} piece(s) are missing to ship the orders that are waiting.
stockOut.fix: Order from your supplier, or call the customers to offer another product.

stockSoon.title: {{count}} products will run out soon
stockSoon.why: At the last 7 days' sales, the first one runs out within {{days}} day(s).
stockSoon.fix: Buy now: the supplier needs time to deliver.
stockSoon.okTitle: No product runs out in the next 5 days

notCalled.title_one: {{count}} new order is waiting for a call
notCalled.title_other: {{count}} new orders are waiting for a call
notCalled.title: {{count}} new orders are waiting for a call
notCalled.why: Waiting for more than 2 h (the oldest: {{hours}} h). A customer who waits changes their mind.
notCalled.fix: Ask the agents to call the oldest ones first.
notCalled.okTitle: Every new order is called within 2 h

lateCallbacks.title: {{count}} callbacks are late
lateCallbacks.why: The time promised to the customer passed more than 1 h ago.
lateCallbacks.fix: Open “Waiting” and call these customers now.
lateCallbacks.okTitle: Promised callbacks are made on time

confRate.title: Confirmation rate is stable
confRate.info: Not enough orders yet to judge confirmation

confRateDrop.title: Confirmation rate is going down: {{now}} % (before {{before}} %)
confRateDrop.why: This week, {{drop}} points less than the week before.
confRateDrop.fix: Listen to some calls, check the cancel reasons and the quality of your ads.

fakeOrders.title: Too many fake orders: {{pct}} %
fakeOrders.why: {{count}} fake or wrong-number orders in 7 days.
fakeOrders.fix: Find which ad or form sends them, and block the numbers that come back.

weakAgents.title_one: {{count}} agent confirms much less than the team
weakAgents.title_other: {{count}} agents confirm much less than the team
weakAgents.title: {{count}} agents confirm much less than the team
weakAgents.why: The team confirms {{team}} % of orders. These agents are far behind (7 days).
weakAgents.fix: Listen to their calls with them and give them the right script.
weakAgents.okTitle: All agents are close to the team ({{team}} %)
weakAgents.info: Not enough calls yet to compare agents

notShipped.title_one: {{count}} confirmed order has not left yet
notShipped.title_other: {{count}} confirmed orders have not left yet
notShipped.title: {{count}} confirmed orders have not left yet
notShipped.why: Confirmed more than 2 days ago (the oldest: {{days}} days). The customer may forget and refuse.

stuckParcels.title_one: {{count}} parcel is stuck with no news
stuckParcels.title_other: {{count}} parcels are stuck with no news
stuckParcels.title: {{count}} parcels are stuck with no news
stuckParcels.why: Shipped more than 8 days ago, and the courier has said nothing for 3 days.
stuckParcels.fix: Call the courier or open a claim.
stuckParcels.okTitle: No parcel stuck at the courier

openAlerts.title: {{count}} delivery alerts are not handled
openAlerts.why: The courier could not deliver. Without action, the parcel comes back.
openAlerts.fix: Call the customer, give the courier a new date.

returns.title: Deliveries are stable
returns.info: Not enough parcels yet to judge returns

returnsUp.title: Too many returns: {{back}} % of parcels come back
returnsUp.why: Delivery rate {{now}} % over 14 days (before: {{before}} %). Each return costs the delivery both ways.
returnsUp.fix: Confirm better (address, date), call before delivery, and check the wilayas that refuse.

badWilayas.title: {{count}} wilayas send many parcels back
badWilayas.why: More than 40 % of parcels come back (30 days).
badWilayas.fix: Ask for a deposit, confirm twice, or stop advertising there.
badWilayas.okTitle: No wilaya sends too many parcels back

ordersDrop.title: Orders are going down: {{yesterday}} yesterday, {{avg}} usually
ordersDrop.why: {{drop}} % less than the average of the 7 days before.
ordersDrop.fix: Check your ads (stopped? budget over?) and whether your site or landing page works.
ordersDrop.info: Not enough orders yet to compare

cashLate.title_one: {{count}} parcel delivered but not paid yet
cashLate.title_other: {{count}} parcels delivered but not paid yet
cashLate.title: {{count}} parcels delivered but not paid yet
cashLate.whyMoney: Delivered more than 10 days ago: {{amount}} to collect.
cashLate.fix: Ask the courier or the delivery man for the payment.
cashLate.okTitle: Money for delivered parcels arrives on time

cpu.title: The processor works too hard: {{pct}} %
cpu.why: The server is slow for everyone when the processor is full.
cpu.fix: Find the task that runs too much, or get a stronger server (more cores).

memory.title: Memory is almost full: {{pct}} %
memory.why: When memory is full, the server can stop by itself.
memory.fix: Restart Pilotix tonight, then add memory if it comes back.

disk.title: The disk is almost full: {{pct}} %
disk.why: {{free}} MB left. Full disk = the database stops and no order comes in.
disk.fix: Delete old logs and backups, clean Docker (docker system prune), or make the disk bigger.

restarted.title: Pilotix just restarted ({{minutes}} min)
restarted.why: If nobody restarted it, it crashed.
restarted.fix: Look at the errors below and the server logs (docker compose logs).

dbPing.title: The database answers slowly: {{ms}} ms
dbPing.fix: Check slow queries, the disk and memory.

dbConnections.title: Too many database connections: {{used}} of {{max}}
dbConnections.why: Soon new connections will be refused.

dbSlow.title_one: {{count}} query stuck for more than 30 s
dbSlow.title_other: {{count}} queries stuck for more than 30 s
dbSlow.title: {{count}} queries stuck for more than 30 s
dbSlow.why: A stuck query can block the others.
dbSlow.fix: Check pg_stat_activity and stop the query if needed.

dbDown.title: The database does not answer!
dbDown.fix: Check that PostgreSQL runs (docker compose ps) and the disk is not full.

dbPoolFull.title: Queries are waiting for a connection ({{waiting}})
dbPoolFull.fix: Raise DB_POOL_MAX or find what keeps the connections.

redisOff.title: Redis is not set: automatic tasks are off
redisOff.why: Without Redis: no automatic parcel tracking, no Dellal, no automatic landing pages.
redisOff.fix: Add REDIS_URL to the .env file, then restart.

redisDown.title: Redis does not answer!
redisDown.why: Automatic tasks (parcel tracking, Dellal…) are blocked.

jobs.title: {{count}} automatic tasks are not working
jobs.why: Time since its last good run:
jobs.fix: See its error in the “Automatic tasks” table, then check the API key or the network.
jobs.okTitle: Every automatic task runs on time
jobs.info: Automatic tasks have not run yet since the start

errors.title: Errors in the code: {{hour}} this hour, {{day}} in 24 h
errors.why: The errors that come back most (times in 24 h):
errors.fix: Fix the one that comes back most first. Give it to Claude with the message.
errors.okTitle: No error in the code for 24 h

courierSync.title: Parcel tracking fails for {{count}} shops
courierSync.why: Their delivery statuses no longer update.
courierSync.fix: Often the courier's API key (ZR…) changed: ask the shop for the new one.

silentShops.title: {{count}} shops no longer receive orders
silentShops.why: They received orders every day, and nothing since (hours):
silentShops.fix: Call the shop: its site, landing page or order link may be broken.

config.title: {{count}} server settings are missing
config.fix: Add them to .env, then restart Pilotix.

turnstile.title: Cloudflare (robots): {{domains}} domains out of {{max}} ({{pct}} %)
turnstile.why: {{widgets}} of {{maxWidgets}} widgets used. When everything is full, shops’ new domains get no robot check (the rest of the protection still works).
turnstile.fix: Before 100 %: move to Cloudflare Enterprise (Turnstile “any hostname”), or open a 2nd free Cloudflare account.

turnstileOff.title: Cloudflare (robots) is not connected
turnstileOff.why: Cloudflare’s invisible robot check protects every shop’s landing pages, for free (up to {{max}} domains).
turnstileOff.fix: Control room › Settings › “Cloudflare (robots)”: paste the Account ID and a Turnstile API token, once. Pilotix does the rest by itself.

meVsTeam.title: Your confirmation rate is below the team: {{me}} % (team {{team}} %)
meVsTeam.why: {{gap}} points less than the team this week.
meVsTeam.fix: Listen to the best agents’ calls and ask your manager for tips.
meVsTeam.info: Not enough calls yet this week to compare you

errs.title: Latest errors
errs.memory: Kept 24 h in memory. A restart clears them.

cf.title: Cloudflare: robot check for every shop
cf.help: Pilotix adds pilotix.online and each shop’s own domain to your Cloudflare Turnstile widgets by itself. The free plan allows 20 widgets × 10 domains = 200 domains.
cf.soon: Already {{pct}} % of the free plan used: plan to move to Cloudflare Enterprise before it is full.
cf.full_one: Free plan full: {{count}} domain is waiting for a place. Move to Cloudflare Enterprise.
cf.full_other: Free plan full: {{count}} domains are waiting for a place. Move to Cloudflare Enterprise.
cf.off: Not connected yet. The owner connects the Cloudflare account once; then everything is automatic.
cf.s1: dash.cloudflare.com › the account’s home page: copy the “Account ID” (32 characters, right column or the account’s “…” menu).
cf.s2: Profile (top right) › API Tokens › Create Token › Custom token: permission “Account › Turnstile › Edit”, then Create.
cf.s3: Paste both here. The token never leaves the server.
cf.demo: Demo: nothing is sent to Cloudflare
cf.lockedOwner: Nobody can edit or delete it. Only you can replace it with a new account or a new token.
cf.lockedOthers: Nobody can edit or delete it. Only the owner can replace it.
cf.replaceHelp: The new one is checked with Cloudflare first. If it is refused, the old one keeps working: the protection never stops.
cf.tokenNew: The new token (Turnstile: Edit). It never leaves the server.
cf.offOthers: Not connected yet. Only the owner can connect it (Settings).

scope.whole: The whole shop: confirmation, depot, delivery, stock, sales and money.
scope.mine: Your own work: your orders and your parcels.
